title: What If the Great Lakes Disappeared Overnight?

scenes.text: What if the Great Lakes vanished tonight? One-fifth of the world's fresh surface water, gone.
They hold about six quadrillion gallons, and about 84 percent of North America's surface fresh water.
More than 40 million people in the US and Canada drink from them. Their taps would be the first thing to go.
The lakes also directly generate more than 1.5 million jobs, from shipping to fishing to tourism.
The basin is home to over 30 million people: about 10 percent of the US and more than 30 percent of Canada.
It isn't just a map that would empty. Forty million taps would, and nothing else matches that on the continent.
